2026_04_LAC_SEA.headline: The winless Chargers take a second straight road test against Seattle’s aggressive defense
2026_04_LAC_SEA.paragraph1: Justin Herbert and the winless Chargers head to Seattle needing cleaner protection and steadier early-down execution after a difficult 0-3 start. Jim Harbaugh has stressed sharper offensive detail, while Seattle counters with Mike Macdonald’s pressure-oriented defense and Jaxon Smith-Njigba’s explosive receiving form on offense. Los Angeles has to keep Herbert out of long-yardage situations and limit Seattle’s extra possessions; the Seahawks can take control if their front consistently compresses the pocket and forces hurried throws.
2026_04_LAC_SEA.model_rationale: Los Angeles needs cleaner offensive sequencing and protection to unlock Herbert, while Seattle can tilt the matchup by creating pressure and forcing the Chargers into predictable passing situations.
